review_kind: Claude AI translation and review (Claude Opus 5.5) on 2026-11-08 of the settings and strings added on the batch2-1108 branch against the exact English source: the division analysis of tracked cells (item 771, alpha): the timelapse_division_analysis, timelapse_division_mode, timelapse_division_window and timelapse_division_size_tolerance labels and tooltips, the 'Division Analysis α' heading and the Division analysis results panel (spacr/qt/widgets/division_panel.py); and the OPS phenotype path settings of items 852, 853 and 857 (ops_ownership, ops_flatfield, ops_flatfield_maps, ops_flatfield_fields, ops_flatfield_field_list, ops_ph_funk_features); and the six tooltips shortened under the 600-character ceiling (crop_scaling, input_statistics, mask_workers_per_gpu, nucleus_min_size, pixel_size_um, timelapse_division_analysis). No native-speaker sign-off.

records.source: How different in size a control cell may be from the dividing cell at the start of the window, as a fraction: 0.25 accepts controls from 0.8 to 1.25 times its area. Smaller values match more closely but leave more divisions without a control. Ignored unless timelapse_division_analysis. Default 0.25.
records.translation: 在窗口起点时，对照细胞与分裂细胞在大小上允许的差异，以比例表示：0.25 接受面积为其 0.8 到 1.25 倍的对照。数值越小匹配越严格，但会有更多分裂找不到对照。仅在启用 timelapse_division_analysis 时生效。默认值 0.25。

records.source: Frames before each division that are aligned and compared. The change is measured from the first frames of this window to the last frames before division, a quarter of the window each (at least 2). Blank uses 0.3 times the median cell cycle observed in the movie, between 4 and 30 frames, or 6 frames when no complete cycle is seen. Ignored unless timelapse_division_analysis. Default None.
records.translation: 每次分裂之前参与对齐和比较的帧数。变化量从该窗口的最初几帧测量到分裂前的最后几帧，两段各占窗口的四分之一（至少 2 帧）。留空时使用影片中观察到的细胞周期中位数的 0.3 倍，限定在 4 到 30 帧之间；若未观察到完整周期，则为 6 帧。仅在启用 timelapse_division_analysis 时生效。默认值 None。

records.source: Correct the uneven illumination of the phenotype fields. 'none' measures the pixels as acquired. 'analytic' corrects the measured intensity features from each cell's mean flat-field gain (phase ph_masks), in about a minute per plate. 'exact' divides every pixel before measuring, so it needs the raw images again. Default 'none'. Alpha.
records.translation: 校正表型视野中不均匀的照明。'none' 按采集时的原样测量像素。'analytic' 根据每个细胞的平均平场增益（ph_masks 阶段）校正已测得的强度特征，每块板约需一分钟。'exact' 在测量前对每个像素做除法，因此需要再次读取原始图像。默认值为 'none'。Alpha。

records.source: A JSON file of [well, site] pairs to build the maps from instead of a random draw, such as the fields.json an earlier build wrote, to rebuild the same maps. Default None. Alpha.
records.translation: 一个由 [well, site] 对组成的 JSON 文件，用于代替随机抽取来构建平场图，例如先前一次构建写出的 fields.json，以便重建相同的平场图。默认值为 None。Alpha。

records.source: How many random fields (seed 0) the ph_flatfield phase builds the maps from. Fewer fields leave cells in the median; 204 built the Funk et al. plate maps. Default 204. Alpha.
records.translation: ph_flatfield 阶段用于构建平场图的随机视野数（种子 0）。视野越少，中位数中残留的细胞越多；Funk et al. 的板平场图由 204 个视野构建。默认值为 204。Alpha。

records.source: The folder holding the plate's flat-field maps, flat_info.json and one flat_*_<channel>.npy per channel. Empty uses the flatfield folder in dst_root, which the ph_flatfield phase fills. Maps are never overwritten. Default None. Alpha.
records.translation: 存放该板平场图的文件夹，包含 flat_info.json 和每个通道一个 flat_*_<channel>.npy。留空时使用 dst_root 中的 flatfield 文件夹，由 ph_flatfield 阶段填充。平场图从不被覆盖。默认值为 None。Alpha。

records.source: Which copy of a cell imaged in two overlapping fields is kept. 'closer_match' keeps the closer sequencing match, as before spaCR 1.5.1.8; it is often the copy cut by the field's edge. 'a1b' keeps the copy from the field in which the sequencing nucleus lies deepest, and 'a1' the one whose phenotype nucleus does. Both also leave out cells that touch a field's edge, which needs the ph_masks phase. Default 'closer_match'. Alpha.
records.translation: 在两个重叠视野中成像的细胞保留哪一份副本。'closer_match' 保留测序匹配更近的副本，与 spaCR 1.5.1.8 之前相同；它往往是被视野边缘截断的副本。'a1b' 保留测序细胞核位于最深处的那个视野中的副本，'a1' 则保留表型细胞核位于最深处的那个视野中的副本。两者都会排除接触视野边缘的细胞，这需要 ph_masks 阶段。默认值为 'closer_match'。Alpha。

records.source: Also measure Funk et al. 2022's features: the mass displacement of every channel and the correlation of every channel pair in the nucleus and the cell, and the form factor of both, as their OpticalPooledScreens code defines them. Adds about 30 columns. Default False. Alpha.
records.translation: 同时测量 Funk et al. 2022 的特征：细胞核和细胞中每个通道的质量位移和每对通道的相关性，以及二者的形状因子，定义与其 OpticalPooledScreens 代码一致。增加约 30 列。默认值为 False。Alpha。

records.source: How raw crops become model input. 'legacy' decodes each crop to 8 bits with the per-crop stretch, as before. 'fixed' divides each plate and channel of the raw crops by one fixed scale (the 99th percentile of object pixels in up to 2,048 training crops), clips at crop_scale_clip, resizes to image_size and normalises with input_statistics on the GPU; it keeps intensity differences between cells and needs Measure crop_intensity 'raw'. With augment: flips, 90-degree rotations, shifts of up to 4 px and a per-channel gain within 10%. Every step is saved in the checkpoint. Default 'legacy'.
records.translation: 原始裁剪图如何转换为模型输入。'legacy' 与以前一样，用逐裁剪图拉伸将每个裁剪图解码为 8 位。'fixed' 将原始裁剪图的每个板和通道除以一个固定缩放值（最多 2,048 个训练裁剪图中对象像素的第 99 百分位），在 crop_scale_clip 处截断，缩放到 image_size，并在 GPU 上用 input_statistics 归一化；它保留细胞之间的强度差异，需要 Measure crop_intensity 'raw'。启用 augment 时：翻转、90 度旋转、最多 4 px 的平移以及 10% 以内的逐通道增益。每个步骤都会保存在检查点中。默认值 'legacy'。

records.source: Mean and standard deviation applied to the model input. 'symmetric' is spaCR's historical 0.5/0.5, mapping [0,1] to [-1,1]. 'imagenet' and 'clip' use those backbones' statistics; with crop_scaling 'fixed', 'imagenet' takes the mean, std and interpolation of the model's torchvision weights. 'dataset' uses per-channel training statistics. 'custom' uses input_mean and input_std. 'auto' picks 'imagenet' for a pretrained backbone, else 'dataset'. Legacy training, and 'auto' when scoring or drawing activation maps, use 'symmetric'. Default 'auto' in Classify, 'symmetric' elsewhere.
records.translation: 应用于模型输入的均值和标准差。'symmetric' 是 spaCR 以往的 0.5/0.5，将 [0,1] 映射到 [-1,1]。'imagenet' 和 'clip' 使用这些骨干网络的统计量；当 crop_scaling 为 'fixed' 时，'imagenet' 采用模型 torchvision 权重的均值、标准差和插值方式。'dataset' 使用逐通道训练统计量。'custom' 使用 input_mean 和 input_std。'auto' 对预训练骨干网络选择 'imagenet'，否则选择 'dataset'。旧版（legacy）训练，以及评分或绘制激活图时的 'auto'，使用 'symmetric'。在 Classify 中默认值为 'auto'，其他地方为 'symmetric'。

records.source: How many mask workers share each GPU. Above 1, Make Masks segments in that many processes per GPU, so one worker loads, normalises, filters and saves while another runs Cellpose and a single GPU stays busy. Without mask_parallel the first GPU is used, with it every GPU it selects. Workers share the card under the GPU memory governor; fewer start when memory within gpu_memory_fraction, less gpu_memory_margin_gb, cannot hold about 5 GB per worker. Each plate's GPU use is printed and written to gpu_utilisation.json. Not for timelapse or t_stack runs. Default 1.
records.translation: 每个 GPU 由多少个掩膜工作进程共享。大于 1 时，Make Masks 在每个 GPU 上用这么多个进程进行分割，因此一个工作进程加载、归一化、过滤和保存时，另一个运行 Cellpose，单个 GPU 得以保持忙碌。未启用 mask_parallel 时使用第一个 GPU，启用时使用它选择的每个 GPU。这些工作进程在 GPU 内存调控器的管理下共享显卡；当 gpu_memory_fraction 范围内的内存减去 gpu_memory_margin_gb 后无法为每个工作进程容纳约 5 GB 时，启动的工作进程会减少。每块板的 GPU 使用情况会被打印出来，并写入 gpu_utilisation.json。不适用于延时成像或 t_stack 运行。默认值为 1。

records.source: (Deprecated) Minimum nucleus size in pixels^2 applied during measure_crop: smaller labels are erased from the nucleus mask before any feature is measured, so they never reach the database. 0 or None disables it. Default 2000, for 40-60x; with pixel_size_um or magnification set, the default is the area of a disc one fifth of Mask's expected nucleus diameter (113 px at 20x, 30 px at 0.325 um/px). A field that loses over half its nuclei prints a warning. Prefer an 'area' row for nucleus in object_filters, which filters at segmentation time.
records.translation: （已弃用）measure_crop 期间应用的最小细胞核大小（像素^2）：更小的标签会在测量任何特征之前从细胞核掩膜中删除，因此永远不会进入数据库。0 或 None 表示禁用。默认值 2000，适用于 40-60x；设置 pixel_size_um 或 magnification 后，默认值为一个圆盘的面积，其直径为 Mask 预期细胞核直径的五分之一（20x 时为 113 px，0.325 um/px 时为 30 px）。某个视野失去超过一半的细胞核时，会打印一条警告。建议改用 object_filters 中针对 nucleus 的 'area' 行，它在分割时进行过滤。

records.source: Image pixel size in micrometres per pixel, for example 0.325 for a 6.5 um camera pixel behind a 20x objective. When set, a blank cell_diameter, nucleus_diameter or pathogen_diameter is the typical object size over the pixel size (18 um cells, 10 um nuclei, 6.5 um pathogens: 55, 31 and 20 px at 0.325 um/px), with area limits diameter^2/4 to diameter^2*10, and Measure scales the default cell_min_size, nucleus_min_size and pathogen_min_size. A diameter you type is used as it is. None uses the magnification default (120 and 60 px at 20x). Default None.
records.translation: 图像像素尺寸，以每像素微米计，例如 20x 物镜后 6.5 um 相机像素对应 0.325。设置后，留空的 cell_diameter、nucleus_diameter 或 pathogen_diameter 为典型对象大小除以像素尺寸（细胞 18 um、细胞核 10 um、病原体 6.5 um：在 0.325 um/px 时分别为 55、31 和 20 px），面积限制为 diameter^2/4 到 diameter^2*10，并且 Measure 会按比例调整 cell_min_size、nucleus_min_size 和 pathogen_min_size 的默认值。您输入的直径按原样使用。None 使用放大倍数默认值（20x 时为 120 和 60 px）。默认值为 None。

records.source: After tracking, ask what tracked cells do before they divide. Each division is aligned on its last frame before the daughters appear, and shape, intensity and motion are compared with control cells from the same movie that are not about to divide (same time, similar starting size, no division in or just after the window). The same cells aligned on a random earlier time are a second control that should show nothing. Writes effect sizes (Hedges' g, bootstrap 95% intervals), trajectories, size control and three figures to tracks/division/<tracks file>/. Default False.
records.translation: 追踪完成后，考察被追踪细胞在分裂前的行为。每次分裂都对齐到子细胞出现前的最后一帧，并将形态、强度和运动与同一影片中并非即将分裂的对照细胞进行比较（时间相同、起始大小相近、窗口内及窗口刚结束后均未分裂）。将同一批细胞对齐到一个随机的较早时间，作为第二个对照，它应当显示不出任何效应。将效应量（Hedges' g，自助法 95% 区间）、轨迹、大小控制和三张图写入 tracks/division/<tracks file>/。默认值 False。

retired_records.source: Which divisions are analysed. fission: the mother's track ends and two daughters start on the next frame, as in bacteria, fission yeast and mammalian cells. budding: the mother goes on and each bud is a new track that starts while she is alive, as in budding yeast; a tracker that keeps one daughter under the mother's id also gives budding. auto takes whichever of the two the movie has more of. Size control is fitted for fission only. Ignored unless timelapse_division_analysis. Default auto.
retired_records.translation: 要分析哪些分裂。fission：母细胞的轨迹结束，两个子细胞在下一帧开始，如细菌、裂殖酵母和哺乳动物细胞。budding：母细胞继续存在，每个芽都是在母细胞存活期间开始的一条新轨迹，如出芽酵母；若追踪器将一个子细胞保留在母细胞的 ID 下，也会得到 budding。auto 选取影片中两者数量较多的一种。大小控制只对 fission 进行拟合。仅在启用 timelapse_division_analysis 时生效。默认值 auto。
